page.layout: One page of text, title and verse poem in the centre; a narrow strip of partly cut-off text at the right edge (margin fragments of the facing page, not transcribed as notes). No running head, no page number.

main_text.head: IN GULIELMI AMESII Demonstrationem LOGICÆ VERÆ.

p.i: Quæ mentis almæ ducis errantem gradum,
Salve, renata, parte ceu quadam tui,
Sed tota rursum. quatenus quicquid domus
Et cruda Veterum placita secure imbibunt.
Scelus est piandum: quicquid indictum Ethnicum

page.notes: Partly cut-off text at the right edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "A" of the opening line is a large woodcut-style initial; "Disce" and "Ethnicum" read with some uncertainty; "Hedera" appears as "Hedera" with a long-s-like form. The line "Scelus est piandum" is set as printed.
